sql: select now() as db_now, (select max(started_at) from incentive_discovery_cycles) as last_discovery, (select count(*) from incentive_discovery_cycles where started_at > now() - interval '30 minutes' and errors > 0) as errored_30m, (select max(created_at) from live_orders) as last_live_order, pg_postmaster_start_time() as pg_started
